activity_summary: You looked at Verona again and did not write a scene. The month is struck. The days are still a blank. Gib's flank covered the outer margin of the page. You did not write a speech, and you are not opening a king. The pen was not taken up.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and did not start a speech.

entities.name: Brooke's Romeus and Juliet
entities.context: Mentioned in Verona, by morning light
